expected.exit_basis: contract-declared placeholder corroborated by the reference child process exit; the product runner ABI is UNBOUND
expected.exit_semantics: A typed refusal requires a non-success case child exit (2 in the reference run) AND the typed token AND zero side effects. A 0 exit carrying the token is NOT a valid refusal. The engine wrapper exit is not the refusal signal. The product runner ABI is UNBOUND in this set.

predicates.assertion: All five mutation names appear exactly once: FLOATING_HEAD, OLD_CANDIDATE_RAW, WRONG_SOURCE_PIN, SCOPE_DRIFT, ORACLE_SWAP.
Every subcase is refused with a typed token drawn from the declared downstream token set; no bare boolean refusal.
predicates.verify: all(s.refused and s.token in {4 downstream tokens} for s in subcases)

predicates.assertion: No subcase invokes the runner; refusal happens at intake, before execution.
predicates.verify: all(s.runner_invoked is False for s in subcases)

predicates.assertion: The refusal path performs zero writes.
The source sentinel digest is bit-identical before and after all five mutations.
The case child process exits non-success (2 in the reference run); the engine wrapper exit 0 is not the refusal signal.

predicate_contract: Each predicate is independently checkable from the produced case record or from the real filesystem. A token match alone never satisfies the oracle; all predicates must hold.
not_covered: The real refusal exit code must be frozen from the real intake ABI; exit 2 is the contract placeholder corroborated only by the reference process exit. Product intake ABI remains UNBOUND.
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; this oracle was frozen before the product run; an oracle change requires a CR and a new case revision; an old FAIL is preserved
